sam.name: Sam
sam.notes: The «حوار» Sami, renamed for the English series. Impatient, hopeful, overconfident life-hacker who wants everything NOW. Big gestures, fast entrances, falls hard. Flaw: no patience. Heart: never gives up. Voice: ElevenLabs v4 'Liam' (takes recorded with audio tags, see voice_src/).

layla.name: Layla
layla.notes: The «حوار» Layla. Calm, dry, deadpan; small precise gestures; the straight man who is secretly fond of Sam. Patient: knits a striped red/teal scarf all episode (B-story). Smiles only once (P09 'It just needed time'). Voice: ElevenLabs v4 'Sarah'.
